ABHIJIT DEY

Senior Manager – Process Excellence | Business Transformation | Lean Six Sigma | AI & Automation

Kolkata, India  |  +91 9874852518 |  abhijitdey581@gmail.com |  LinkedIn

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Operations, Process Excellence & Transformation Leader with 15 years of experience across BPO/KPO, P&C Insurance and Finance & Accounting, combining Lean Six Sigma, business transformation, operational excellence, client consulting and digital transformation. Experienced in leading global client portfolios, process discovery, DMAIC-based improvement, operating-model design, AI/RPA automation, stakeholder engagement and measurable benefits realisation. Currently leads operations for 100+ global clients and 400+ professionals while driving Process Excellence, continuous improvement, capability building and AI-led transformation.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Lean Six Sigma / DMAIC / Statistical Analysis / Hypothesis Testing / Regression / Correlation / DOE / SPC / FMEA / RCA / CAPA / Kaizen

Process Excellence / Process Discovery / Process Mapping / Value-Chain Analysis / Gap Analysis / Process Re-engineering / Operating Model Design

Business Transformation / Continuous Improvement / Change Management / Transformation Governance / Benefit Realisation

Client Consulting / Executive & Client Presentations / QBRs / Stakeholder Influencing / Cross-functional Leadership

AI / GenAI / Agentic AI / RPA / Power Automate / AI Solution Design / Automation Governance / ROI Tracking

Capability Building / Training / Coaching / Mentoring / TNA / SOP & Knowledge Management / KPI & Governance Frameworks

Power BI / Minitab / Visio / Advanced Excel / PowerPoint

SELECTED JD-ALIGNED HIGHLIGHTS

Led end-to-end Process Excellence and transformation initiatives across global insurance operations, combining Lean Six Sigma, process analytics, root-cause analysis and digital solutions.

Conducted Process Discovery through process mapping, gap analysis, opportunity identification and use-case development; presented transformation scope and cost-benefit cases to clients and stakeholders.

Applied advanced LSS statistical tools including hypothesis testing, regression, correlation, DOE, SPC, FMEA, Pareto, RCA and CAPA to identify root causes and validate improvement outcomes.

Built and drove continuous-improvement and capability-building practices through TNA, coaching, training interventions, knowledge sharing and cross-functional collaboration.

Led client-facing transformation discussions, governance reviews and QBRs; influenced business, operations, technology, quality and training stakeholders to secure adoption and sustain improvements.

Led AI/RPA initiatives from opportunity assessment and business case/use-case development through POC, UAT, deployment, governance and benefits realisation.

Designed functional AI solution architectures and drove adoption of RPA, GenAI and Agentic AI solutions while monitoring confidence metrics, knowledge-management needs and post-implementation performance.

Fostered a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and digital-first thinking across multi-client operations and global stakeholder groups.

Delivered quantified Lean Six Sigma and automation outcomes including 35.9% policy-issuance TAT improvement and $3.8M annualised savings; 70% reduction in QA coverage with improved process capability; and GenAI-led efficiency gains across multiple clients.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Sr. Manager – Lifecycle & Operations (US P&C and Health Insurance) | Xceedance Consulting India Pvt. Ltd. | Kolkata | Mar 2025 – Present

Lead end-to-end service delivery across Agency and Broker lifecycle operations for 105 clients and 405 professionals, ensuring SLA adherence, backlog management, service continuity and escalation resolution.

Drive portfolio-wide operational governance through KPI reviews, capacity/workforce planning, productivity, quality, TNA, capability building, data-driven decision making, cost management and account growth.

Manage strategic client relationships through governance calls and QBRs, identifying operational improvement, transformation and growth opportunities.

Lead Process Excellence, operating-model design, business transformation and digital initiatives across the insurance value chain.

Conduct process mapping and gap analysis; identify improvement opportunities, develop use cases and present scope, cost-benefit and transformation cases to clients.

Design business and functional solution architectures for AI and automation initiatives; translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions.

Lead automation from opportunity assessment and POC through UAT, deployment, governance and benefit realisation; drive adoption of RPA, GenAI and Agentic AI.

Lead change management and stakeholder engagement to drive adoption of operational excellence, automation and AI-led transformation.

Foster continuous improvement, innovation and digital-first thinking through cross-functional collaboration and emerging technologies.

Sr. Manager – Operations & OPEX | Marble Box Solutions | Kolkata | Jul 2023 – Feb 2025

Led end-to-end service delivery for 101 clients and 375 professionals with portfolio governance across KPI, capacity, productivity, quality, capability building, cost and account growth.

Led Process Excellence and transformation initiatives by identifying high-impact opportunities and developing use cases across the process value chain.

Applied Lean and Six Sigma to identify operational risks, design operating models and drive process improvements supporting strategic business decisions.

Developed functional AI solution architecture and partnered with automation teams to implement intelligent automation; established automation governance and monitored ROI.

Collaborated across operations, technology, quality and training teams to ensure adoption and sustained process improvement.

Sr. Manager – Operations | Marble Box Solutions | Kolkata | Aug 2020 – Jun 2023

Managed multi-functional Service Delivery and Quality operations for 95 clients and 310 professionals.

Drove Lean management and process optimisation to improve productivity, reduce waste and enhance service quality.

Used KPI trends, capacity planning, productivity tracking, quality analysis and corrective actions to drive operational improvements.

Led client governance, transformation discussions, service improvements and capability-building initiatives.

Operations Manager / Assistant Manager – Operations | Marble Box Solutions | Kolkata | Jan 2014 – Jul 2020

Managed Agency and Broker lifecycle operations across multiple clients and teams, with responsibility for SLA/KPI performance, productivity, quality, client communication and escalation management.

Coordinated with Training, Transition, Quality and Delivery teams for operational readiness; conducted coaching and training interventions based on capability needs.

Established and optimised operational processes and frameworks to improve service continuity, accuracy, compliance and service effectiveness.

Earlier Experience

Senior Online Media Executive – Engagement Media Pvt. Ltd. | 2017

Process Associate – Veridian Solutions | US P&C Insurance | 2012–2013

Associate Consultant – Finance & Accounts – Capgemini India | 2011–2012

KEY BUSINESS IMPACT

GenAI integration in renewal policy comparison for 30 clients: 70% efficiency improvement, capacity equivalent to 12 FTEs/week and $350K annualised savings.

GenAI integration in Direct Bill Reconciliation for 75 clients: 58% efficiency improvement, capacity equivalent to 10 FTEs/week and $34K annualised savings.

DMAIC-led policy issuance improvement: TAT reduced from 10.8 to 6.52 days (35.9% improvement), process capability improved from 2.6σ to 3.8σ and $3.8M annualised savings.

Quality transformation across 125 P&C insurance clients: accuracy improved from 95% to 99%, process capability improved from 3.33σ to 4.6σ, QA coverage reduced by 70% and $365,100 annual savings.

Lean-based improvement in non-client delivery work: cycle time reduced by 28%, efficiency improved from 24% to 42% and 3.5 hours/person/week saved.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

MBA – Finance | Institute of Management & Development, New Delhi | 2008–2010

B.Com – Accountancy | S.S. College, Bokaro | 2003–2006

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt

Agile Project Management

Power BI

AI Tools & ChatGPT Workshop

IMPORTANT SCREENING VALIDATION

Note: The profile above strengthens only areas supported by the CV. Formal ownership of BB/GB/YB programme mobilisation, examinations/certification administration, Process Excellence community events, and Bloom Flow/idea-platform replication should be added only after the candidate's specific screening answers are documented.
